changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_competitions_discipline
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_competitions_region
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_competitions_niveau
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_competitions_date_debut
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS name VARCHAR(255)
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS type VARCHAR(50)
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS start_date DATE
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS end_date DATE
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS registration_deadline TIMESTAMP
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pool_id BIGINT
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by BIGINT REFERENCES users(id)
ALTER TABLE competitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'PLANIFIEE'
UPDATE competitions SET name = nom WHERE name IS NULL AND nom IS NOT NULL
UPDATE competitions SET start_date = DATE(date_debut) WHERE start_date IS NULL AND date_debut IS NOT NULL
UPDATE competitions SET end_date = DATE(date_fin) WHERE end_date IS NULL AND date_fin IS NOT NULL
UPDATE competitions SET status = statut WHERE status IS NULL AND statut IS NOT NULL
UPDATE competitions SET type = 'NATATION' WHERE type IS NULL
UPDATE competitions SET status = 'PLANIFIEE' WHERE status IS NULL
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nom
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS discipline
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS date_debut
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS date_fin
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS lieu
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS region
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS niveau
ALTER TABLE competitions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS statut
ALTER TABLE competitions ALTER COLUMN name SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE competitions ALTER COLUMN type SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE competitions ALTER COLUMN start_date SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE competitions ALTER COLUMN end_date SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE competitions ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_competitions_status ON competitions(status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_competitions_start_date ON competitions(start_date)
